name: Uncategorized — 4 Level 4 — Soul of the Land

system.description:
This extremely powerful ritual grants the caster an almost complete identification with his domain, becoming "one with the land" and instantly knowing of anything that threatens it. He can sense problems with the soil, locate hostile forces, predict weather, and exercise subtle control over the land's features — shifting trees to obscure paths, redirecting streams, or raising boulders to block a mountain pass.

System: The caster buries himself in a grave near the center of his domain for one full day. Upon rising, he drinks an infusion of his blood combined with the soil in which he lay, uniting his essence with the land's. Periodic expenditures of blood (eight blood points per week) maintain the connection indefinitely; if a week passes without renewal, the connection breaks and the ritual must be repeated.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers
system.bloodCost: 8 blood points per week to maintain
